items.title: Scaffold experiments/pos-instrument-replay/ and a committed viability harness (viability-check.mjs) that applies each candidate tamper class (x raw|refreshed) to an mkdtemp-isolated copy of a small baseline, runs verify, and records the observed fingerprint over the explicit domain plus a disposition (fail-closed|accepted|dropped)
items.context: Candidate classes from plan section 6.1: records.jsonl byte-flip / row drop / row duplicate / row reorder / field rename / truncation (raw + selected refreshed); gold-queries.json edit (raw + refreshed); manifest.json recordCount/profile/digest edit (raw only); cross-PROFILE swap. Mutation-in-isolated-copy only; never touch the source baseline. refreshManifest logic (recompute recordsDigest/goldDigest, rebuild manifestDigest) is replicated from the smoke.
items.userSees: node experiments/pos-instrument-replay/viability-check.mjs prints a disposition table: each candidate (class x raw|refreshed) tagged fail-closed | accepted | dropped, ending with counts e.g. 'fail-closed=15 accepted=2 dropped=0'.

happy.desc: node viability-check.mjs against a fresh small baseline prints a per-(class x handling) disposition table and a summary line with fail-closed/accepted/dropped counts; observed fingerprint recorded per class

edge.desc: the harness only mutates mkdtemp-isolated copies; the source baseline dir digests are unchanged after a full run (no source-tree pollution)

adversarial.desc: a candidate whose mutation produces NO byte/contract difference (verify identical to clean) is classified dropped, exactly as the rev-1 seed-swap no-op would be

items.title: Freeze protocol.json via a committed producer (build-protocol.mjs) that emits protocol.json + its sha256 from the viability results plus frozen constants
items.context: protocol.json content per plan section 7: N per scale (proposed 30 small / 3 full, full-N finalized from calibration), content-inert seed constant with contentInert:true annotation, tamper matrix split into fail-closed set (each with expected fingerprint over flags+numeric predicates) + acceptance bucket + dropped list, iterationId rule + cross-product, recordDigest preimage rule, budget caps, stop-reason enum {budget_cap,verify_crash,precondition_failed,operator_abort}, env pins {nodeVersion,platform,instrumentCommit}. Producer must be deterministic and re-emit a byte-identical protocol.json (hash reproducible).
items.userSees: node experiments/pos-instrument-replay/build-protocol.mjs writes protocol.json + protocol.json.sha256 and prints the frozen hash; a second run prints the identical hash (byte-identical re-emit).

happy.desc: node build-protocol.mjs emits protocol.json and its sha256; running it twice yields byte-identical protocol.json (stable hash)

edge.desc: protocol.json contains the fail-closed set (each with fingerprint over flags+numeric predicates), the acceptance bucket, the dropped list, N per scale, content-inert seed const, iterationId cross-product rule, recordDigest preimage rule, budget caps, stop-reason enum, and env pins

adversarial.desc: every class in the fail-closed set has a fingerprint with at least one required-false flag OR a failing numeric predicate (no vacuous H2 class)

items.title: Run ONE full-profile (1,000,000-record) generate+verify and record the measured cost (elapsedMs, peakRssBytes) to calibrate the full budget cap and final full-N; record env pins
items.context: This is the sole heavy compute in M0. Capture the measured full-profile elapsed + rss into a committed calibration record that build-protocol.mjs consumes to set the budget cap and freeze full-N. Small verify measured ~7.3s hands-on.
items.userSees: node experiments/pos-instrument-replay/calibrate-full.mjs (or the build step) records calibration.json with measured full-profile elapsedMs + peakRssBytes + chosen full-N and env pins; prints 'full-profile: <ms>ms rss=<bytes> -> full-N=<n>'.

happy.desc: one full-profile (1,000,000-record) generate+verify runs and calibration.json records elapsedMs, peakRssBytes, and the finalized full-N + budget cap

edge.desc: env pins {nodeVersion, platform, instrumentCommit} are recorded in calibration.json / protocol.json

adversarial.desc: if the full-profile run cannot complete within budget, an honest budget_cap/stop is recorded rather than a fabricated cost number

items.title: Add a hermetic mkdtemp-isolated selfcheck runnable by node <file> for the viability harness and the protocol producer, asserting protocol.json re-emits byte-identical (hash stable) and every fail-closed class fingerprint carries a failure signal
items.context: Per plan section 7 selfchecks row: hermetic, mkdtemp-isolated, run by node <file>. The selfcheck guards reproducibility of the freeze and the two-pronged viability invariant.
items.userSees: node experiments/pos-instrument-replay/selfcheck.mjs exits 0 and prints 'selfcheck PASS' (hermetic, mkdtemp-isolated).

happy.desc: node selfcheck.mjs runs hermetically in mkdtemp isolation and exits 0 with a PASS line

edge.desc: selfcheck asserts build-protocol.mjs re-emits protocol.json byte-identical (hash stable)

adversarial.desc: selfcheck asserts the two-pronged invariant: every fail-closed class fingerprint carries a failure signal; it fails loudly if a vacuous class is present

items.title: Emit the reuse-audit smoke-overlap map: for each candidate tamper class, annotate whether and which existing smoke case in packages/main/src/tasks/playbook-runtime-memory-baseline-smoke.ts already covers it, and carry that annotation into protocol.json
items.context: Plan section 8 M0 Delivers column names a documented map of which tamper classes the existing smoke already covers (INIT-002 gap flagged by both INIT reviewers). Naturally produced during CHK-001 viability by tagging each class with smokeOverlap {covered:bool, smokeCase?:string}; classes already smoke-covered are re-asserted through the harness for ledger completeness (cheap), not re-engineered. The frozen protocol.json records the overlap per class so the reuse audit is a committed artifact, not prose.
items.userSees: protocol.json contains a smokeOverlap {covered, smokeCase?} annotation per candidate class; grep shows net-new classes as covered:false and smoke-covered ones naming their smoke case.

happy.desc: protocol.json records a smokeOverlap {covered:bool, smokeCase?:string} per candidate class (the reuse-audit map)

edge.desc: classes already exercised by playbook-runtime-memory-baseline-smoke.ts are annotated covered:true with the specific smoke case name

adversarial.desc: a net-new class (e.g. records-byte-flip) is annotated covered:false (not falsely claimed as smoke-covered)
